runners.comment: Weak form in three runs last summer, out of her depth in a winners' race at Bellewstown
runners.spotlight: Hard to make a case for her on the form of three runs last summer; totally out of her depth when taking on previous winners at Bellewstown.

runners.comment: Best form has been over longer distances, hard to be sure if this trip will suit
runners.spotlight: Second over 2m3f at Limerick last season; signs of return to form with recent Punchestown fourth over 2m4f; hard to be sure if trip will suit.

runners.comment: Very weak maiden form, in good hands and starts in handicaps off a very low base
runners.spotlight: Very weak maiden form; in good hands and starts in handicaps off a very low base.

runners.comment: Has shown virtually nothing over hurdles, cheekpieces fitted for handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Twice placed on the Flat; has shown virtually nothing over hurdles; cheekpieces fitted for handicap debut.

racecards.race_name: Bar One Racing "Extra Place Races At The Cheltenham Festival" Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Progressive since joining this yard; ran 2 crackers last year; fitness is the concern
runners.spotlight: Progressive after joining this yard in 2023, winning his first two starts for this trainer; came on from last season's return to finish a close fourth in a Listed Handicap Hurdle at the Punchestown Festival and went close at Ballinrobe subsequently; 286-day absence is a concern but he would be a major player if fit.

prev_owners.owner: Mark Devlin & Philip Smith & Nigel O'Hare & Claire Wylie

runners.comment: Gr 2 novice hurdle winner in pomp; 3rd in h'cap chase when last seen; might need this
runners.spotlight: Grade 2 novice hurdle winner in his pomp and showed he's just as effective over fences with two wins early this season; last seen finishing third in a handicap chase at the Galway Festival; testing ground would be fine but has a modest record fresh so might be best watched after 217 days off.

quotes.race: Sky Bet Moscow Flyer Novice Hurdle (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: His preparation wasn't ideal and that's maybe why Dreal Deal drifted. He will probably go for the Supreme but will be entered in the Ballymore as well. That was the dream but he had to go and do that today - Ronan McNally, trainer.

quotes.race: WhatOddsPaddy Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: He has had a busy time of it and will probably have a break now until after Christmas. Things will be getting more difficult for him, but a strongly run 2m should suit him nicely and we will target one in the new year - Ronan McNally, trainer.

quotes.race: Download The BETDAQ App Ladies Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Dreal Deal got a very cool ride from Maxine, she got him settled and jumping beautifully. He's in at Cork on Sunday, depending on what the handicapper does. If he goes there he will come back in the Spring because he is more of a good ground horse - Ronan McNally, trainer

runners.comment: Career best in November but not as good since and h'capper may have him
runners.spotlight: Career best at Fairyhouse in November but hasn't built on that in three runs since and handicapper may have him at present.

quotes.race: Fairyhouse Membership 2025 Rated Hurdle
quotes.quote: Any Road disappointed me last season. I wasn't confident today, it being his first run. He should get into the good handicap here at the end of the month. I was very pleased with him, especially on the ground - Edward O'Grady, trainer

runners.comment: Gr 2 winner; distant 4th in this season's Morgiana; not as good in h'caps since
runners.spotlight: Grade 2 winner in December 2022; ran as well as could have been expected when a distant fourth in the Morgiana; however, has struggled in handicaps over this trip twice since and his better form is over shorter.

quotes.race: Coolmore NH Sires Kew Gardens Hurdle (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: I'm surprised but it's brilliant. No Looking Back was a bit of an unknown after winning in Thurles. He's a horse that Oliver and the team have loved. Johnny Barry has always thought lots of him and he proved him right today. When I quickened him he picked up over the last, and hopefully he can progress again. He landed running and galloped to the line. You'd have to be surprised going from a maiden to open company - Phillip Enright, jockey

quotes.race: Thurles Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: No Looking Back won his bumper in similar fashion here. He didn't do a pile when he hit the front but he had to get there. His jumping was okay but he will be sharper the next day - Oliver McKiernan, trainer.

quotes.race: www.thurlesraces.ie (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: No Looking Back surprised me, because when I walked the track I didn't think it was soft enough. He'll be heading to Fairyhouse for the big sales bumper there. I wasn't expecting him to win there but delighted he did - Oliver McKiernan, trainer.

prev_owners.owner: Exors of the Late Jeremiah Nolan

runners.comment: Back to form 4th last week but doesn't appear to have anything in hand from this mark
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a fourth behind Thedevilscoachman at Leopardstown last week but he's exposed and he wouldn't appear to have anything in hand from this sort of mark.

quotes.race: Timeless Sash Windows Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: I was a bit worried about the ground but Darragh (O'Keeffe) said it was no problem. I could never get Lord Erskine into a good race with a light weight and it was the same on the Flat. He'd a proper weight on his back today and there was a good gallop which suited him. His (late) owner Jerry Nolan was a pure gentleman. I rode winners for him and having an owner like him, you couldn't buy them - Harry Rogers, trainer.

quotes.race: Friends Of The Curragh Pollardstown Handicap
quotes.quote: We ran Lord Erskine at Listowel the other day and it just didn't work out. He does want two miles and that ground. I stuck the blinkers on him on Friday morning and that made the difference but he loves that ground and the trip. He's just easy to train and he's very laid-back, that's what's wrong with him, he just does what he wants and doesn't kill himself - Harry Rogers, trainer

quotes.race: Treo Eile Retraining Ireland's Racehorses Handicap
quotes.quote: We had to resort to plan B as Lord Erskine missed the break and had to sacrifice a couple of lengths to get him to the outside, but it worked out thankfully. That is his minimum trip as he is slow, but full of stamina. He was owned by the late Jerry Nolan and I'm delighted for connections - Harry is a big supporter of mine and himself and Miriam work very hard. I'm delighted for them. He is a yard stalwart, loves the track and is as genuine as they come.  - Siobhan Rutledge, rider.

quotes.race: BetVictor Run For Your Money Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: He's a decent horse on his day but he's had problems and it's just taken a long time to get him back. He was a bit keen today and the jumping seemed to wake him up a little bit. He handles that ground well and stays well. Hopefully things stay right with him, it's a long time since he won the Irish Cesarewitch here. He'll keep on going over the winter - Harry Rogers, trainer of Lord Erskine

quotes.race: Ryans Cleaning Event Specialists Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Lord Erskine is a nice horse and hopefully he can get another one. He's in again at Clonmel next week so we'll see how he comes out of this - Harry Rogers, trainer.

quotes.race: Strandhill Caravan Park Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: He's 18 in the ballot at Tipperary but that might bring him up a bit. He'll probably stay over hurdles for a while. He wants a dig in the ground and he wouldn't want it any quicker than that. Hopefully he might end up at Galway and if all goes well he'd scrape into the amateur race - Harry Rogers, trainer

quotes.race: Irish Cesarewitch (Premier Handicap)
quotes.quote: He was weak when we got him but he has progressed very well. They went a decent gallop and that suited him. He's a good horse and we might head for the Naas November Handicap next. He does like a good ease in the ground - Harry Rogers, trainer

quotes.race: John & Terry Moriarty Memorial Handicap
quotes.quote: He wouldn't be in love with the ground but he got away with it. When they get off in front here it seems to be hard to catch them. He's in at Ballinrobe next Thursday over hurdles but he hasn't really taken to hurdles so far. We might be better off keeping him on the Flat and go back over hurdles next year -  Harry Rogers, trainer

quotes.race: Sean Cleary Memorial Handicap
quotes.quote: He was unlucky in Tramore, Rachael Blackmore gave him a good ride but he was just too free. The plan was always to come here and when Pat Smullen is available, it's a help. He done it well and he's in at Navan on Saturday, where if there's any rain, he'll probably take his chance. The handicapper might give him 5lb or 6lb - Harry Rogers, trainer

runners.comment: Didn't jump well over fences on return but not ruled out back over timber; may need this
runners.spotlight: Didn't jump well when pulled up on this season's return over fences at Punchestown; not ruled out back in this sphere having looked progressive a couple of seasons ago but chance he'll need this after 106 days off.

runners.comment: Took form to a new level on quicker ground last summer but has been off 232 days
runners.spotlight: Took his form to a new level in the summer, chasing home Harsh in a handicap hurdle at Punchestown before going one better in a handicap hurdle at Roscommon; beaten favourite at Cartmel when last seen; has won on testing ground but improved form came on quicker surfaces than what he'll get here and he's been off 232 days.

quotes.race: Midsummer's Day With The Stars On Sunday, 23rd June Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: West Away got a very good ride from Dylan and it was good to reward him. He has developed into a good horse. He had been running in good quality races for the grade so it was great to win one. He could go to Cartmel for a big pot - John McConnell, trainer.

runners.comment: Won h'cap hurdles on testing ground 2 years ago; lost his way in last 12 months; blinkers
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles on testing ground a couple of seasons ago; however, has lost his way in the last 12 months and he's still above his last winning mark; wears first-time blinkers.

quotes.race: Powered By Bluegrass Novice Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Ottoman Style was very good at Gowran and again today. I planned to hold on to him a bit longer on the deeper ground today and when I asked him he lengthened. He's still learning - Conor Maxwell, rider.

quotes.race: Downpatrick Racecourse Raises 50,000 Euros  For The Ukraine Crisis Appeal Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Ottoman Style was doing his best work at the finish. He was slowly away, the plan was to be a lot closer, but his jumping kept us in it. He's going to be a proper good chaser in time, John's after improving him again. His jumping is impeccable. All he does is stay galloping - Thomas Reilly, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: This half-brother to Brahma Bull, a 154-rated chaser, was an easy winner of his only point-to-point at Borris House 11 months ago. He looks a lovely individual who will be going down the novice hurdle route this season. He works like a stayer and his schooling over hurdles has been great. 28-09-21

runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker who bolted up here latest and shaped like new trip may be fine; up 10lb
runners.spotlight: Hat-trick seeker having just his seventh start over timber and fourth run in a handicap; both wins here, staying on really well to get the better of Gabbys Cross a fortnight ago, suggesting this step back up in trip may be fine; 10lb rise is justified and ought to go well again.

quotes.race: William Hill Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: It was ideal conditions for Duke Of Leggagh. He jumped a lot better today. I knew he had improved from the last day, but I didn't think he had improved that much. We'll probably go back to the Flat with him now and he really does like that ground - Mick Mulvany, trainer.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Duke Of Leggagh ran well last day and on his Flat form he was entitled to win that. Guts won it for him. We'll mix it between this and the Flat but he wants ground like that - Mick Mulvany, trainer

quotes.race: Bective Restaurant Handicap
quotes.quote: Duke Of Leggagh had to win today, trying to win going up 12lb was going to be hard, but he's a lovely horse in the making. It took a while for the penny to drop last year, but it did on his last run at Galway and he is improving all the time. Gary said he had a bit left - Mick Mulvany, trainer

runners.comment: Won twice here; back to form behind Duke Of Leggagh latest; big ask to reverse form
runners.spotlight: Won twice here last season and back to something like his best behind Duke Of Leggagh here last time out but hard to see him turning that form around, despite returning 10lb better off at the weights with that rival.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: American Money is what he is but he's a good solid horse. He'll probably go chasing at some stage. He's qualified for the final of this series at Punchestown, so that's where we'll target him - Eddie Harty, co-trainer

quotes.race: Bar One Racing "Download The Mobile App" Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: American Money is a nice horse but we have no great plans for him. We'll have to look at the next division up now and he's a nice fun horse. He'll make a nice chaser in time and he will improve - Eddie Harty, joint-trainer.

runners.comment: Improving; behind 2 nice prospects in maiden hurdle latest; new trip should suit h'capping
runners.spotlight: Getting better with each run and chased home two nice prospects in a maiden hurdle at Punchestown last month (including Kainsbourg who runs in the maiden hurdle on this card); pedigree suggests he could be an improver stepping up in trip and his opening mark looks workable.

runners.comment: Shaped like return to form was imminent in May and encouraging 5th here on return
runners.spotlight: Shaped like a return to form might be imminent at Ballinrobe in May and encouraging return over 2m7f here a fortnight ago; return to 2m4f may help and one for the shortlist.

quotes.race: Grant Thornton Ladies Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Cato's Revenge seemed to like it and was impressive. The horse is a big type, you'd like to see him over fences in time - Phidelma Elvin, rider

runners.comment: Winning start for this yard but tailed off twice since; probably on stiff enough mark
runners.spotlight: Winning start for this yard in a mares' hurdle at Wexford in October but tailed off twice since, including here latest; questions to answer and probably on a stiff enough mark regradless.

runners.comment: Improved to finish 2nd on return and form of subsequent win at Limerick has worked out
runners.spotlight: Well held on sole run last season but plenty to like about her staying on second in a maiden hurdle at Clonmel and went one better at Limerick last time; form of her Limerick win has worked out nicely and on a good mark for her handicap debut here.

quotes.race: Earl Of Harrington Mares Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Uhavemeinstitches is a lovely filly who we've liked from day one. She jumped so well early on that she was jumping into the back of one or two of them, but she was really good at the last two. She had a little look when she got to the front, but Simon [Torrens, jockey] said she found plenty when he got after her. She really filled out her frame during the summer and when she came back to us in the autumn, I was really delighted with her. I knew I had a mare to train then. She's only four rising five, so hopefully there's plenty to come. Stamina will probably be her forte down the line - James Motherway, trainer.

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner and back to form with Thurles 2nd but beaten fav since on soft
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner at Listowel last summer and back to form when runner-up in a Thurles novice in December but was a beaten 11-10 favourite back on softer ground at Fairyhouse in January; workable mark for handicap debut if he handles conditions.

quotes.race: Shay Rooney Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: The yard are in form and all the summer horses are flying. I liked Heroes Rise, he'd done nothing wrong on his previous runs, although greenness probably beat him. He travelled, settled, jumped and did everything right - Carl Millar, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: He won nicely at the Listowel meeting in June, but has been a shade disappointing since and didn't get home at Galway on Sunday. 28-10-24

runners.comment: Lost his way this term but could bounce back from his reduced hurdle mark
runners.spotlight: Bolted up in a novice handicap chase here last season; lost his way over fences this term but there's a chance he'll bounce back from her reduced hurdle mark here.

quotes.race: Nas Na Riogh Novice Handicap Chase (Listed)
quotes.quote: Battle It Out had a nice light weight and it was a proper test whcih is what he wants. He'll be a lovely horse next year, he is still only a frame - Conor O'Dwyer, trainer.

quotes.race: Follow Us On Social Media Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Battle It Out is a smashing big horse. He has done nothing but improve and is still doing so. A summer's break is beckoning for him - Conor O'Dwyer, trainer

runners.comment: Bumper winner last season; shaped with promise but needs to improve to defy this mark
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner at the beginning of the season and has shaped with promise in maiden hurdles since but needs to improve to defy this mark now handicapping.

runners.comment: Tailed off in 3 runs since maiden hurdle success; best watched until showing more
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in her three starts since her maiden hurdle success at Down Royal last season; best watched until she shows more.

racecards.race_name: Bar One Racing "Guaranteed Overnight Prices" Beginners Chase

runners.comment: Bumper winner and some good runs over timber but pulled up latest; tough ask on chase bow
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; good runs in defeat over timber last season but pulled up on heavy ground last month on yard debut and tough ask on debut over fences on the back of that; wears first-time hood.

runners.comment: Won h'cap hurdle in November off 119; not as good twice since; tough ask on chase debut
runners.spotlight: Won handicap hurdle at Punchestown off 119 but not as good over further twice since; probably needs to take his form to a new level on chase debut and second-string on jockey bookings.

stable_tour.quote: He won his only point-to-point at Dromahane and jumped particularly well there so I've no doubt he will turn out to be a better chaser than hurdler. He'll start off in a beginners' chase soon. 28-10-24

runners.comment: Won back-to-back over timber in handicaps last season; hasn't taken to fences this term
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back over timber in handicaps last season; hasn't taken to fences this term and pulled up latest.

quotes.race: David Trundley Artist At Punchestown Novice Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Buachaillbocht has won three, he's going the right way and might win another one - Ted Walsh, trainer.

quotes.race: Join The Punchestown Members Club Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Buachaillbocht was better today than at Tramore, that track might have been a bit tight for him. It was atrocious ground there too and he just didn't travel. He travelled well today and stayed it out well. He was entitled to do that, he is only six and he's improving - Ted Walsh, trainer

runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner; well held in two chase starts so far but step up in trip should help
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle and a novice hurdle last term; well held in two chase starts so far but step up in trip should help.

quotes.race: Punchestown Members Club From 215 Euros Rated Novice Hurdle
quotes.quote: I was delighted when I saw we were going to get Limerick ground again. Built By Ballymore just handles the muck so well. He might not quicken up in it but he keeps going in it. I thought his rating was high enough, but he just handles that ground better than most - Martin Brassil, trainer.

quotes.race: CUBE Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Built By Ballymore is a big raw horse and will take a while to come to himself. I was happy enough where I was sitting, I kicked on two out and he will have learned loads from that - Conor Brassil, rider.

runners.comment: Won a handicap hurdle off 105 last season but shown nothing in either chase start so far
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle off 105 last season but shown nothing in either chase start so far.

runners.comment: Career best over timber in January but came down 3 out on chase debut; career best needed
runners.spotlight: Career best when winning over timber at Gowran in January but came down 3 out when coming under pressure on chase debut; needs to take his form to a new level here.

runners.comment: Showed a good level of ability 2 seasons ago; nothing so far this term inc' chase bow
runners.spotlight: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner who wasn't disgraced in graded company over timber a couple of seasons ago; missed last term, tailed off over timber on return and beaten a distance in a beginners' on chase debut last month; questions to answer now.

runners.comment: Tailed off in beginners' on chase debut but useful hurdle form and may do better
runners.spotlight: Tailed off behind Ile Atlantique in a beginners' on chase debut in December; finished runner-up in a Grade 3 over timber last season and yard's representatives often make better chasers so may do better in this sphere at some stage.

stable_tour.quote: I was thrilled with him at Naas and he looks to be a very nice horse. There's a Graded novice hurdle at Navan before Christmas over two and a half miles and that's the place we're heading with him next. 20-11-23

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner on this card last term; good 4th to Dancing City but poor run since
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner on this card last year and ran a cracker behind stablemate Dancing City on his chase debut this season, despite making a host of errors; however, his jumping caught him out when a beaten favourite in a beginners' at Navan since; shorter trip may not help with his jumping but he's a big player if he can put in a clear round.

runners.comment: Progressive over timber in 2023 but surely best watched on chase debut after 677 days off
runners.spotlight: Progressive over timber in 2023, getting his head in front when last seen but surely best watched on chase debut after 677 days off.

runners.comment: Big run on chase debut at 2023 Galway Festival and belated return wasn't devoid of promise
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner a few seasons ago and there was a lot to like when runner-up to Mars Harper on his chase debut at the 2023 Galway Festival in beginners' company; shaped like he needed his only subsequent start in another Galway beginners' in October and could be a big player if he comes on for that first start in 451 days.

quotes.race: Ballagh INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: Sir Argus is still very green and changed his legs and was leaning left and right and I think there is more improvement in him. He has a fantastic staying pedigree and will be better when he gets a trip - Patrick Mullins, rider.

runners.comment: Point winner; promise over timber but tailed off when 150s for beginners' since
runners.spotlight: Point winner; promising without winning over timber but tailed off when 150-1 for a Thurles beginners' last month; needs to leave that run behind.

stable_tour.quote: Looked smart when winning his point and he's definitely better than he showed in a bumper on bottomless ground at Gowran Park 28-10-24

runners.comment: Progressive over timber last term; promise over fences so far but errors have cost him
runners.spotlight: Progressive over hurdles last season; errors have cost him over fences this term; was roughly 6l behind Majborough when coming down at the last on chase debut; respectable effort despite finishing fourth of four but was tailed off after making errors at Gowran since; will be involved if he can put a clear round together.

quotes.race: Franciscan Well Rated Novice Hurdle
quotes.quote: Western Fold was keen with me two runs back and I rode him to get settled today. He did it well and will get further - Jack Kennedy, rider

runners.comment: Missed most of last term and shown nothing in two chase starts; needs to jump much better
runners.spotlight: Missed most of last season and shown nothing in two chase starts; needs to jump a lot better this time.

quotes.race: Monroe's Live John Monroe Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Can't Stop Smiling is lightly raced and was running around a little bit but her jumping was very good. When she switches off she has plenty of toe at the finish - Charlie O'Dwyer, rider.

runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner in Dec 2022; only five runs since; beaten at short odds on chase bow
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in December 2022; only five runs since and was a beaten short-priced favourite on this season's return/chase debut at Limerick on St Stephen's Day; hard to gauge now but longer trip may help.

quotes.race: Signsplus Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Foxy Girl has a fair bit of scope. She jumps quickly and put her head down. It's early days yet but she had good placed form and is one to look forward to - Mike O'Connor, rider.

stable_tour.quote: She runs very well fresh and can then disappoint, so we've tried a few changes with her. She's very well and will start off in a beginners' chase when we can get some ease in the ground. 18-11-24

She's a lovely mare who came to us from France having finished second on her only run at Auteuil. She was runner-up again on her debut for us at Thurles in early December but really came on for that run and won at Limerick in good style over Christmas. The runner-up, In Excess, franked that form with a good win next time out. Foxy Girl is in good order and the plan is for her to go for the Ryanair Mares' Novices' Hurdle. 01-03-23

racecards.race_name: Bar One Racing Leinster National Handicap Chase (Listed Race)

runners.comment: All five career wins have been gained at this venue including this event two years ago
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of lower hurdles mark to win a Listed 2m4f handicap at this venue last season; out of form since but should not be ruled out since all five career wins have been gained at this venue, including this event two years ago.

quotes.race: Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: Espanito Bello is a classy type of horse. They went a mad pace in front which suited him. He jumped super. We've had all the older horses in a good bit longer this summer and they would normally take a run, but all the older horses are straighter this year. We'll give him another go, maybe in the Proudstown Handicap Hurdle at Navan - Barry Connell, owner/trainer.

quotes.race: Bar One Racing Leinster National Handicap Chase (Grade A)
quotes.quote: Espanito Bello is in the Irish National but we would only run him if the ground came up soft. I ran him in it once before but he wasn't right and the ground was too quick. He's going to go up a bit for that and is entitled to step back into Graded company at some stage as well - Barry Connell, trainer.

quotes.race: Ballymore Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: Espanito Bello loves it around here and had a lovely run here last time after making a couple of novicey mistakes. He learned from that today. I thought he would run well today but that was an awesome performance. I had the Grade 3 over 3m here in January in mind for him - Barry Connell, trainer.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: He has been ready to run since November but he didn't have his ground. We always liked him though and he did that nicely. Hopefully the ground stays soft for a while and we think he's well entitled to run in a nice novice somewhere - Alan Fleming, trainer of Espanito Bello

quotes.race: Rushe's Supervalu (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: We bought him as a two-year-old in France. He has a real roundy action so testing ground at Naas in January was ideal for him - Barry Connell of Espanito Bello

runners.comment: Tailed off on stable/seasonal debut at Clonmel and pulled up in Grade 3 at Tramore
runners.spotlight: Very useful for Willie Mullins, notably when placed in 3m1f Grade 1 novice event at Cheltenham and Aintree the season before last; lost form last season, pulled up final two outings; tailed off on stable/seasonal debut at Clonmel and pulled up in Grade 3 at Tramore; down 12lb from career-high mark.

quotes.race: Soil.ie Working With Fairyhouse Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: I'd say Bronn doesn't do a whole lot in front and was looking around an awful lot. I thought I had him beaten comfortably going to the last, but he started pulling up a bit from the back of the last with me. He's toughed it out well. There is more room for improvement with his jumping, though he's getting better - Daryl Jacob, rider

stable_tour.quote: He's a real chasing type and was third in Grade 1s at Cheltenham and Aintree last season. He could start off in a Listed chase at Thurles this month and will be going down the staying handicap route, possibly races like the Coral Gold Cup, Paddy Power Chase at Leopardstown or Irish National. He could also get an entry in the National at Aintree and the Welsh National. 13-11-23

runners.comment: Disappointed when 7-1 chance in a valuable Leopardstown event, plenty to prove as a result
runners.spotlight: Only chase win was in a beginners' event at Punchestown in 2022; best handicap form represented by second placing in 27-runner Paddy Power at Leopardstown last season; disappointed when 7-1 chance in same event this season; plenty to prove as a result.

quotes.race: Ladbrokes Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: We only decided after Panda Boy ran here at the Festival to go chasing with him. I always felt he was a good-ground horse. His action always suggested to me that he wanted decent ground and chasing is his game. We may give him a little break now - Martin Brassil, trainer.

quotes.race: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)
quotes.quote: We think a lot of the horse. Panda Boy just needed distance and his ground - Martin Brassil, assistant trainer.

quotes.race: I.N.H. Stallion Owners EBF Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Panda Boy is a big, weak horse and he is only starting to furnish. The more dry weather we were getting the more hopeful I was. His future is over fences but we will try and find a hurdle race before the end of the season - Martin Brassil, trainer.

runners.comment: Veteran was a gallant second in last year's Irish Grand National, asking a lot at 13
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in the Grand National; most recent win was in a Grade 2 chase at Navan two seasons ago; took time to find his form last season before being produced in fighting shape for the Irish Grand National in which he finished a gallant second; veteran should be better for last month's reappearance at Fairyhouse.

quotes.race: Webster Cup Chase (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now did it nicely and didn't do any more than he had to. Denis was very happy with him. He popped away nicely, got under the last a bit, but when he grabbed hold of him after the last he quickened up well - Ted Walsh, trainer

quotes.race: Randox Grand National Handicap Chase (Grade 3) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now is a great, consistent horse, he ran his heart and soul out. Mark said he missed the break a little bit and didn't get travelling as well as he normally does. But then he jumped well and travelled well and I thought at the last we might just get there - Ted Walsh, trainer.

quotes.race: Tote Bobbyjo Chase (Grade 3)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now is in good nick and he will go to Aintree in good nick. It was a tidy race and I'm delighted to have got a race into him six weeks from the National - Ted Walsh, trainer.

quotes.race: Randox Grand National Handicap Chase (Grade 3) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now was very unlucky, he very nearly got brought down at the third last and he's done great to finish third - Mark Walsh, jockey.

quotes.race: Webster Cup Chase (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now is a smart horse and he showed at Naas last year that he is capable over two. I'd say that was a career best and it will send him to the Grand National in a good frame of mind. If he takes to the place, travels and jumps, and gets a bit of luck, he won't be far away - Ted Walsh, trainer.

quotes.race: WhatOddsPaddy? Chase (Grade 3)
quotes.quote: Any Second Now travelled and jumped well. He stays well and things worked out well today and he was nicely treated. He'll go to Aintree with a good chance - Ted Walsh, trainer

quotes.race: Fulke Walwyn Kim Muir Challenge Cup Amateur Riders' Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Ted gave me great encouragement to ride Any Second Now and everything worked out brilliantly. He'd been mixing it with good horses in Graded chases and relished the extra trip on that ground ? he really galloped all the way to the line - Derek O'Connor, jockey.

quotes.race: Sky Bet Moscow Flyer Novice Hurdle (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: I was happy turning in that he was going to be third to two fair horses and when he picked up he did it well. It's a tight 2m around here and he was going as quick as he wanted to at times too. He cruised through Navan and he probably didn't learn a whole lot. He's a raw sort of horse but he could be a very good horse - Ted Walsh, trainer of Any Second Now

runners.comment: Won this race last year off 9lb lower, two mishaps over fences, confidence boosted latest
runners.spotlight: Made a bright start for this yard last season, winning a beginners' event at Clonmel before giving a good staying performance to win this race; has two mishaps over fences in December; had a confidence-boosting run when second off his much lower hurdles mark here time; 9lb higher than for last year's win.

quotes.race: Bar One Racing Leinster National Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: We weren't really sure whether Hartur D'Arc would stay this trip but we said we'd pitch him in here and see. It's a lovely pot to win. Sean (Flanagan) gave him a nice ride and everything went right for him. He's in the Irish National. I know it's over a lot further but you'd have to consider it - Gavin Cromwell, trainer.

quotes.race: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: Hartur D'Arc did it well and is a very good horse. It didn't really go to plan up the straight. I wanted to stay out but had to switch in on the worst of the ground. It took him a while to get going but he pulled up like a fresh horse. It didn't take much out of him and he will come on from the run - Declan Lavery, rider.

stable_tour.quote: He was very good when he won the Leinster National in March and I'm not sure he stayed the trip in the Irish National on his final run. He's not a slow horse and we'll bring him back in trip for his first run back - he's in the Troytown and the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham and the plan is for him to start in one of them. 12-11-24

He isn't a slow horse and we'll bring him back in trip for his first run back - he's in the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham and the plan is for him to start in that race. 13-11-24

runners.comment: Useful 126-rated hurdler has achieved a 9lb higher rating over fences in three starts
runners.spotlight: Useful 126-rated hurdler has achieved a 9lb higher rating over fences in three starts; went close at Fairyhouse on second attempt, despite jumping indifferently and racing in snatches; solid display against the smart Three Card Brag at this venue could go well for Anna McGuinness.

runners.comment: 0-10 over fences, was set a tough task in the Thyestes on his comeback after long absence
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over fences but has run well in defeat, notably when second in the 2023 Munster National; last season's campaign ended prematurely after being brought down in the Troytown; set a tough task in the Thyestes on his comeback; should strip fitter.

quotes.race: Follow Us On Instagram Maiden Hurdle (Div I)
quotes.quote: Largy Debut had been working really well coming here, we thought he was a nice horse coming. Our fellow jumps and travels and we told Keith to be positive. He has been doing everything right since and he is a really nice horse - David Roche, assistant trainer.

stable_tour.quote: It was very frustrating to see him exit so early in the Troytown. He ran so well in the Munster National and we were really looking forward to seeing how he would get on at Navan. He's settling better now. 20-11-23

runners.comment: Good run in the Thyestes, flopped when favourite for the National Trial at Punchestown
runners.spotlight: Won three of his last four starts last season, culminating in a valuable novice handicap win at Navan; raised 12lb for that, ran respectably without the benefit of a run when fifth in the Thyestes, weakening after a bad mistake two out; flopped when favourite for National Trial at Punchestown last month; first-time chekpeices now.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Handicap Chase Final (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: I was delighted with Bushmans Pass. It was a good battle. I love a good battle when I win it, but I wouldn't like to be second in a battle like that! If the ground was soft at Punchestown there is a 3m6f race and he'd definitely go there. We're delighted with that. He's coming along, the handicapper wasn't easy on him early on - Oliver McKiernan, trainer.

runners.comment: A long time since his last win, has run over inadequate trips on last two starts
runners.spotlight: 2-19 over fences; over two years since her chase wins were achieved back-to-back at Punchestown (2m7f) and Fairyhouse (2m5f); best 2024 when second in a valuable Punchestown handicap; has run over inadequate trips on last two starts, this should suit better.

quotes.race: Tote Always SP Or Better At Punchestown Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: Must Be Obeyed was good and tough. I didn't know if she was up to winning that. I knew she would love the ground, staying chasing is what we talked about and the test of stamina really tested her - Tom Gibney, trainer.

runners.comment: Signed off last May with a fine effort, should be better for reappearance at Gowran
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable novice handicap at Navan in March 2023 off 107; ran only three times last season; fine effort when touched off in a Listed handicap chase at Punchestown off 124; should be close to a peak again now following last month's Gowran run.

runners.comment: Creditable fourth in last year's Thyestes, no sign of his best form since, mishaps lately
runners.spotlight: 2-13 over fences; finished a creditable fourth in last year's Thyestes despite a mistake at the last; no sign of his best form since; out of contention when unseating two out at Limerick in December; clipped heels and unseated before the first in the National Trial.

quotes.race: Tipper Road Novice Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Stormy Judge stayed on really well today and three miles will be his trip. He can handle soft - Pat Fahy, trainer.

runners.breeder: A & Mrs C Chevalier Du Fau
runners.comment: Stayed on well behind Monbeg Park over 2m5f at Leopardstown last Sunday, trip should suit
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row early in 2023; has finished second in three of his five starts since returning from a lengthy spell on the sidelines; backed up a promising Windsor run when staying on well behind Monbeg Park over 2m5f at Leopardstown last Sunday; would have been closer but for interference; extra distance should suit.

quotes.race: Bar One Racing Bet In-Play Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
quotes.quote: Tyre Kicker looked flat out the whole way on that better ground. He probably wants slower ground and he might be put away after this - Gavin Cromwell, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He ran a belter after a long layoff when second at Galway last month. He's in the Troytown but probably won't get in and if he does he'll be a bit out of the handicap. You'd have to be happy with his return and hopefully there's a nice staying chase in him. 12-11-24
He ran a belter after a long layoff when second at Galway last month. Hopefully there's a nice staying chase in him. 13-11-24

runners.comment: Boasts a solid record over fences, did not last out the 3m3f of the National Trial
runners.spotlight: Boasts a solid record over fences, with three wins and three seconds from ten starts; had two handicap hurdle runs before a return to chasing sparked a revival in form when winning a 2m4f handicap at Cork; did not last out the 3m3f of the National Trial.

quotes.race: Clinton Higgins Chartered Accountants Novice Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Kings Halo jumped and travelled, Danny got the fractions right. The drop back in trip made no difference. The ground and weigh suited him - James Dullea, trainer.

runners.comment: Mildly positive run at Navan four weeks ago, now 13lb below his career-high mark
runners.spotlight: Suffered a severe loss of form not long after his victory in the 3m5f Porterstown Chase at Fairyhouse last season; mildly positive run at Navan four weeks ago, and now 13lb below his career-high mark, 6lb below last winning mark.

quotes.race: Bar One Racing "Guaranteed Overnight Prices" Porterstown Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: Street Value deserved this. He took a terrible fall here at Easter when we thought we lost him. For him to come back and do that on a big day is unbelievable. Hopefully he could come back here for an Irish National some day - John Flavin, trainer.

quotes.race: GAIN Handicap Chase
quotes.quote: Street Value loves soft ground. I was going to run at Leopardstown but it wasn't soft enough and we just had to wait. We'll see what the handicapper does - John Flavin, trainer.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Street Value is just a big galloper and was tough as nails. Barry John let the race just develop in front of him and he was tough at the end. It was a hard slog and he'll get two or three weeks off now - John Flavin, trainer.

quotes.race: Tipperary Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Street Value is a grand horse and Hugh [Morgan] said he was flat out all the way, he only got rocking and rolling at the bottom of the hill. With a circuit to go I thought we could be in trouble but he's just a big, honest, old baby. Looking at the size of him, I'd say whatever he does over hurdles is a bonus and he's a chaser in the making - John Flavin, trainer

runners.comment: Won a mares' bumper at Thurles, well held by Switch From Diesel on Leopardstown running
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; 170,000euros purchase unseated when holding every chance in her sole point-to-point; well-backed when making a winning Rules' debut in a mares' bumper at Thurles; well held by Switch From Diesel on Leopardstown running.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: Blue Velvet  looks like a really nice type and looks one for the Dublin Racing Festival mares' bumper. Hopefully then she will go across the water - Willie Mullins, trainer

runners.comment: Runner-up in two editions of a Grade 2 event at Leopeardstown, cam make experience count
runners.spotlight: 1-9 in bumpers; placed six times,including twice second to a Willie Mullins-trained rival in the Grade 2 mares' event at the DRF; Tipperary winner for Seamus Fahey last season; had a reverse when odds-on at Limerick on first start for this stable; back to peak form when chasing home Bambino Fever at the big Leopardsrown meeting.

runners.comment: Fair sixth at Kilbeggan on summer ground, has struggled in two subsequent outings
runners.spotlight: Not a bad effort on sole start for former yard when beaten 13l sixth on debut at Kilbeggan last June; has struggled in two subsequent outings.

runners.comment: In rear at Killarney last July, remote seventh at Limerick in December, safe to rule out
runners.spotlight: In rear at Killarney last July; remote seventh at Limerick in December; safe to rule out.

runners.comment: Completely tailed off in bumper outings at Liimerick and Gowran, tongue-tie on now
runners.spotlight: Completely tailed off in bumper outings at Liimerick and Gowran; tongue-tie on now.

runners.comment: Ran in a point in 2023, decent pedigree, stable has a 9-28 record in bumpers this season
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam point winner, closely related to winners Court Maid (bumpe/hurdle/chase) and Wilcos Mo Chara (bumper/ hurdle); made mistakes when last of five finishers in a maiden point at Ballynoe two seasons; has joined Declan Queally who has a 9-28 record in bumpers this season; hooded.

runners.comment: Made some late progress on her debut over C&D, considerable improvement required
runners.spotlight: Made some late progress on her debut over C&D; considerable improvement required.

runners.comment: First foal out of Apple's Jade,  gets 17lb from previous winner Switch From Diesel
runners.spotlight: First foal out of the outstanding Apple's Jade; raced a bit too keenly when losing out to a longer-priced stablemate on debut in a four-runner contest at this venue last month; may settle better this time with the experience under her belt; gets 17lb from previous winner Switch From Diesel in what looks like a match.
